decisions.reason: Turnaround management software close to the core offer has had its own page in both years, which suggests results meet aspirations, and the expanding firm has the slack to keep developing it.
The connectivity module moved from a mention to a page of its own, signalling rising commitment and acceptable early results that fit the firm's push toward integrated digital apron operations.
Billing software was promoted to a page of its own in 2024, and since it supports the expanding software and service business there is no shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
Equipment monitoring builds on the large installed base, supports service revenue and was upgraded on the website, so management would keep it while the firm grows and has slack.
